name: NuScale Power
description: NuScale is a pre-commercial reactor designer: it has developed a small modular reactor (the NuScale Power Module, 77 MWe each, combinable up to 12 modules or 924 MWe) and is the first and only small modular reactor design to receive a Standard Design Approval from the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission. It has no plant under construction. Revenue is tiny and lumpy (31.5 million dollars in 2025, 37.0 million in 2024; only 640 thousand dollars in the first half of 2026), coming from engineering services and licensing, mostly to related parties such as Fluor (the largest stockholder) until 2025. Losses are large (net loss 664.5 million dollars in 2025 versus 348.4 million in 2024; reasons for the increase not extracted), but it holds about 1.9 billion dollars of cash and investments and no debt at June 30, 2026. Its commercial path runs through ENTRA1 Energy, its exclusive global partner for selling and developing plants, and two prospects: RoPower in Romania (a joint venture of Nuclearelectrica and Nova Power and Gas, first project at Doicesti) and a non-binding September 2025 plan for ENTRA1 and the Tennessee Valley Authority to develop up to 6 GW of nuclear power. A shareholder class action was filed against it in February 2026.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code 3443 (Fabricated Plate Work). NuScale designs and licenses a reactor but does not yet sell a power plant.

hq.note: 1100 NE Circle Blvd., Suite 350, Corvallis, OR 97330 (FY2025 10-K cover); workforce also concentrated in Houston, Texas

businessLines.name: Technology licensing and engineering services
businessLines.how: Fees for engineering studies, licence rights and, later, a share of module and plant sales through ENTRA1. It also owes ENTRA1 milestone contributions under the August 27, 2025 Partnership Milestones Agreement for each module expected to be placed in a plant, so it may pay out cash before it earns revenue.
businessLines.description: Sells engineering work, licences its design and, through ENTRA1, aims to sell NuScale Power Modules and plants; one customer (RoPower) and one prospective customer (ENTRA1) as of the FY2025 10-K.

revenue.note: 2024: 37.045; 2023: 22.810; 23.921 million of 2025 revenue was from related parties; H1 2026 revenue 0.640 million (Q2 2026 0.075 million, after a 175 thousand dollar price reduction agreed with Fluor)

businessLines.revenueNote: 2024: 37.045; 2023: 22.810; 23.921 million of 2025 revenue was from related parties; H1 2026 revenue 0.640 million (Q2 2026 0.075 million, after a 175 thousand dollar price reduction agreed with Fluor)

operatingProfit.note: Loss from operations; H1 2025: -78.409. Gross margin 11.4 million in 2025 (32.1 in 2024).

brands.name: ENTRA1 Energy
brands.share: Holds exclusive worldwide rights to commercialize, sell and develop NuScale plants; TVA and ENTRA1 signed a non-binding plan on Sept 2, 2025 for up to 6 GW

brands.name: Fluor
brands.share: Fluor was 92% of Q2 2025 revenue and 69% of H1 2025 revenue (7.4 and 14.7 million dollars); no Fluor revenue in Q1 2026

brands.name: RoPower Nuclear (Romania, Doicesti)
brands.share: Technology licensing agreement signed July 2024 for a 6-module 77 MWe plant design; the first module deployment still needs a binding scope of supply and an engineering, procurement and construction contract

whatsNext.text: ENTRA1 and TVA: possible next phase depends on power purchase agreements between ENTRA1 and TVA (September 2025 non-binding agreement for up to 6 GW)
